value.signature: fn compare_header (header : & VerifiedHeader , expected : & HeaderParts , disclosure : & AuthenticationFields ,) -> Result < () , EncodingError >

review.body: { let actual = & header . parts ; if actual . body != expected . body { return Err (EncodingError :: Body) ; } if actual . commitments . proposal != expected . commitments . proposal || actual . commitments . proposal . bytes . as_slice () != disclosure . proposal_precommitment { return Err (EncodingError :: Proposal) ; } if actual . commitments . content != expected . commitments . content { return Err (EncodingError :: Content) ; } if actual . commitments . dependency != expected . commitments . dependency { return Err (EncodingError :: Dependency) ; } if actual . actor_signature != expected . actor_signature || actual . actor_signature . as_slice () != disclosure . actor_proposal_signature { return Err (EncodingError :: ActorSignature) ; } if actual . content_edition != expected . content_edition || actual . content_edition != disclosure . content_edition { return Err (EncodingError :: ContentEdition) ; } if actual . dependency_edition != expected . dependency_edition || actual . dependency_edition != disclosure . dependency_edition { return Err (EncodingError :: DependencyEdition) ; } if header . bytes != disclosure . verified_header { return Err (EncodingError :: Canonical) ; } decode_material (& disclosure . public_verification_material , & disclosure . authentication_edition) ? ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: Complete public arguments and results are recorded, including retained bytes. This operation establishes representation or comparison only, never signature validity, secret possession or chain authority.
